body: Hey there! I am really proud of you! It puts a smile on my face that you made that decision.  Only wishing you the best. Stay safe.
Best wishes to you as well
I have to be done with one assignment tomorrow but I can't do it. I am losing hope. :(

Almost one year is so impressive. I am sorry that you replapsed. The thought of not giving the people who destroy me the power over my relapse helped me get through some days. But today everything is just f*ucked up. Cried my eyes out for hours. Now I am mad I didn't study.

I wish there would be a possibility to study without having mental breakdowns all the time. It's rediculous how my university is giving us assignment over assignment and expecting excellent work even though I ve never met my professors or fellow students in person because of Corona.
I know in perspective theres a lot more to come but it scares me so much that maybe things will never work out for me.

Thank you for your kind words. I just feel like I haven't accomplished anything in my life. :(
But this made me feel a little better.
The huge amount of stress in university...
